lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੇ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saaree keete paasaa dhaalan aap lagaa ||26||
lines.translation: He made all beings and creatures his chessmen, and He Himself threw the dice. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhabhai bhaalahi se phal paavahi gur parasaadee jinh kau bhau paiaa ||
lines.translation: Bhabha: Those who search, find the fruits of their rewards; by Guru's Grace, they live in the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh phirahi na chetahi mooRe lakh chauraaseeh pher paiaa ||27||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, and they do not remember the Lord; the fools are consigned to the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਬ ਚੇਤਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)mai mohu maran madhusoodan maran bhaiaa tab chetaviaa ||
lines.translation: Mamma: In emotional attachment, he dies; he only thinks of the Lord, the Love of Nectar, when he dies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਵਰੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੰਮਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa bheetar avaro paRiaa ma(n)maa akhar veesariaa ||28||
lines.translation: As long as the body is alive, he reads other things, and forgets the letter 'm', which stands for marnaa - death. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਯਯੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਦ ਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: yayai janam na hovee kad hee je kar sach pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: Yaya: He is never reincarnated again, if he recognizes the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aakhai guramukh boojhai guramukh eko jaanai ||29||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh speaks, the Gurmukh understands, and the Gurmukh knows only the One Lord. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raarai rav rahiaa sabh a(n)tar jete keee ja(n)taa ||
lines.translation: Rarra: The Lord is contained among all; He created all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭ ਲਾਏ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)t upaai dha(n)dhai sabh laae karam hoaa tin naam laiaa ||30||
lines.translation: Having created His beings, He has put them all to work; they alone remember the Naam, upon whom He bestows His Grace. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਲੈ ਲਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: lalai laai dha(n)dhai jin chhodee meethaa maaiaa mohu keeaa ||
lines.translation: Lalla: He has assigned people to their tasks, and made the love of Maya seem sweet to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਣਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: khaanaa peenaa sam kar sahanaa bhaanai taa kai hukam paiaa ||31||
lines.translation: We eat and drink; we should endure equally whatever occurs, by His Will, by His Command. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੇਸੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vavai vaasudeu paramesar vekhan kau jin ves keeaa ||
lines.translation: Wawa: The all-pervading Transcendent Lord beholds the world; He created the form it wears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: vekhai chaakhai sabh kichh jaanai a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa ||32||
lines.translation: He beholds, tastes, and knows everything; He is pervading and permeating inwardly and outwardly. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ੜਾੜੈ ਰਾੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: RaaRai raaR karahi kiaa praanee tisahi dhiaavahu j amar hoaa ||
lines.translation: Rarra: Why do you quarrel, O mortal? Meditate on the Imperishable Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਓਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi dhiaavahu sach samaavahu os vitahu kurabaan keeaa ||33||
lines.translation: and be absorbed into the True One. Become a sacrifice to Him. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haahai hor na koee daataa jee upaai jin rijak deeaa ||
lines.translation: Haha: There is no other Giver than Him; having created the creatures, He gives them nourishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: har naam dhiaavahu har naam samaavahu anadin laahaa har naam leeaa ||34||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, be absorbed into the Lord's Name, and night and day, reap the Profit of the Lord's Name. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiRai aap kare jin chhodee jo kichh karanaa s kar rahiaa ||
lines.translation: Airaa: He Himself created the world; whatever He has to do, He continues to do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਇਰ ਇਵ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩੫॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kare karaae sabh kichh jaanai naanak saair iv kahiaa ||35||1||
lines.translation: He acts, and causes others to act, and He knows everything; so says Nanak, the poet. ||35||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 3 patee ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehl, Patee - The Alphabet:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਯੋ ਅੰਙੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਾਖੈ ਘੰਙੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ayo a(n)ngai sabh jag aaiaa kaakhai gha(n)ngai kaal bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Ayo, Angai: The whole world which was created - Kaahkai, Ghangai: It shall pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੀਰੀ ਲਲੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪੜਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: reeree lalee paap kamaane paR avagan gun veesariaa ||1||
lines.translation: Reeree, Laalee: People commit sins, and falling into vice, forget virtue. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man aisaa lekhaa too(n) kee paRiaa ||
lines.translation: O mortal, why have you studied such an account,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਣਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lekhaa denaa terai sir rahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: which shall call you to answer for payment? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧੰਙਾਇਐ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidha(n)ngaaiai simarahi naahee na(n)nai naa tudh naam laiaa ||
lines.translation: Sidhan, Ngaayiyai: You do not remember the Lord. Nanna: You do not take the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਛੈ ਛੀਜਹਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਜਮਿ ਪਾਕੜਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chhachhai chheejahi ahinis mooRe kiu chhootahi jam paakaRiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Chhachha: You are wearing away, every night and day; you fool, how will you find release? You are held in the grip of death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਬੈ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: babai boojhahi naahee mooRe bharam bhule teraa janam gaiaa ||
lines.translation: Babba: You do not understand, you fool; deluded by doubt, you are wasting your life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਓ ਪਾਧਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anahodaa naau dharaaio paadhaa avaraa kaa bhaar tudh laiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Without justification, you call yourself a teacher; thus you take on the loads of others. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਜੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jajai jot hir laee teree mooRe a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavahigaa ||
lines.translation: Jajja: You have been robbed of your Light, you fool; in the end, you shall have to depart, and you shall regret and repent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਹਿਗਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ek sabad too(n) cheenahi naahee phir phir joonee aavahigaa ||4||
lines.translation: You have not remembered the One Word of the Shabad, and so you shall have to enter the womb over and over again. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੜੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅਵਰਾ ਨੋ ਨ ਸਿਖਾਲਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh sir likhiaa so paR pa(n)dit avaraa no na sikhaal bikhiaa ||
lines.translation: Read that which is written on your forehead, O Pandit, and do not teach wickedness to others.
